shortDescription: Haymaker Acquisition Corp V (HYAC) has priced its initial public offering of 25M units at $10.00 per unit, generating $250M in gross proceeds.The units are scheduled to begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange on September 17, 2026, under the ticker symbol "HYACU," with the offering expected to…

children: of 25M units at $10.00 per unit, generating $250M in gross proceeds.
The units are scheduled to begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange on September 17, 2026, under the ticker symbol "HYACU," with the offering expected to close on September 18, 2026.
Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one-third of a redeemable warrant, with whole warrants exercisable at $11.50 per share.
Once separate trading commences, the Class A shares and warrants will list under the symbols "HYAC" and "HYACW," respectively.
The full $10.00 per unit raised will be placed into a trust account at closing, and underwriters have been granted a 45-day over-allotment option to buy up to an additional 3.75M units.

As a blank check company, Haymaker V was formed to execute a business combination across any sector or stage of development, though its primary focus will center on targets within the industrial, consumer, and consumer-related products and services industries.

The leadership team is headed by Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer Christopher Bradley, alongside a board that includes Brian Shimko, Harris Heyer, Walter McLallen, William Heyer, and James Heyer.

title: Haymaker Acquisition Corp V prices $250M IPO at $10.00 per unit ahead of NYSE launch
